headlines.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Stock Cools After Q3 Earnings Powerhouse
headlines.summary: Constellation Energy just posted Q3 2026 numbers that lit up the income statement while the share price cooled off. After a strong run into the print, the stock slipped about 3% today. That reaction clashes with a quarter that delivered US$5.19 in earnings per share and pushed trailing earnings to US$12.66 per share, alongside a reported 12.8% net margin for the past year. The real story is sentiment. Short term traders focused on the pullback.

headlines.title: Surprised By Constellation Energy's Slide? What Investors Missed
headlines.summary: If you had hesitated on Constellation Energy at the start of 2026 because bullish analysts sounded too optimistic and the bearish camp warned about nuclear headwinds, the outcome would have looked very different to those forecasts. For Constellation Energy shareholders, the loss from the start of the year was 26.6%, including dividends. With that result in hand, which early sign, policy risk, or business assumption would you want to revisit first?

description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
